prompt: refactor the api to use sqlalchemy
expected_output: Creates services/yolo/models.py with PredictionSession and DetectionObject SQLAlchemy ORM classes. Creates services/yolo/db.py with create_engine, SessionLocal, and get_db() generator. Updates services/yolo/app.py to import from models and db, calls Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine) at module level, removes import sqlite3 and from contextlib import closing, removes init_db() and save_prediction_session() and save_detection_object() functions, adds db: Session = Depends(get_db) parameter to all database-touching endpoints. Refactors tests to stop using app.DB_PATH, init_db(), sqlite3.connect(), or raw SQL seeding. All existing endpoints remain at the same paths with the same status codes and response JSON shapes.
assertions: services/yolo/app.py does not contain 'from contextlib import closing'
services/yolo/app.py contains 'from models import PredictionSession as PredictionSessionORM'
services/yolo/app.py contains 'from models import DetectionObject as DetectionObjectORM'

prompt: add an endpoint GET /predictions/recent that returns the 10 most recent prediction sessions
expected_output: Adds a new GET /predictions/recent endpoint to services/yolo/app.py. The endpoint accepts db: Session = Depends(get_db), queries PredictionSessionORM ordered by timestamp descending, limits to 10 results, and returns a JSON list. Each item in the list contains at minimum uid and timestamp fields. No raw SQL is used. All previously existing endpoints are unchanged. A test is added for this endpoint.
assertions: services/yolo/app.py contains 'Depends(get_db)' in the new endpoint signature
The endpoint returns HTTP 200 with a list
The list contains at most 10 items

prompt: add a UserFeedback table to track user ratings per prediction
expected_output: Adds a new UserFeedback SQLAlchemy model class to services/yolo/models.py. The model has at minimum: id (Integer primary key), prediction_uid (String foreign key referencing prediction_sessions.uid), rating (Integer), and created_at (DateTime). Does not modify any existing endpoint. Does not use raw SQL. Runs Base.metadata.create_all so the new table is created automatically on next startup.
assertions: Existing model classes PredictionSession and DetectionObject are unchanged

prompt: add a column processing_time_ms to the prediction_sessions table
expected_output: Adds processing_time_ms = Column(Float, nullable=True) to the PredictionSession class in services/yolo/models.py. Updates the POST /predict endpoint in services/yolo/app.py to populate this column when saving a prediction session. Does not change the response shape of any existing endpoint. Does not use raw SQL or ALTER TABLE statements.
assertions: services/yolo/app.py does not contain raw SQL strings
The POST /predict response shape is unchanged

prompt: make the database backend configurable so we can use postgres in production
expected_output: services/yolo/db.py reads DB_BACKEND, DB_USER, and DB_PASSWORD from environment variables. When DB_BACKEND=postgres, constructs a postgresql:// connection URL. When DB_BACKEND is absent or set to sqlite, uses sqlite:///./predictions.db. The connect_args={"check_same_thread": False} is only passed for SQLite. No hardcoded credentials appear in the source file. All existing endpoints behave identically regardless of backend.
assertions: services/yolo/app.py does not contain any database URL or connection string

expected_output: Creates or updates a test file under services/yolo/tests/ for the POST /predict endpoint. Tests use FastAPI TestClient. A conftest.py exists with db_session and client fixtures that use SQLAlchemy with a temporary SQLite database and override the get_db dependency via app.dependency_overrides. The YOLO model is mocked with a FakeModel class. No test file contains import sqlite3, sqlite3.connect, init_db, or app.DB_PATH. Tests assert HTTP 200 for valid image uploads and HTTP 400 for non-image files.
assertions: A test file for /predict exists under services/yolo/tests/
Test file contains a FakeModel or equivalent mock class
Test asserts response.status_code == 200 for valid image
Test asserts response.status_code == 400 for non-image file
